## SURFACE
Two-col whitespace-sep spectral file. x descending (47183→1648), comma-decimal numbers (EU/German locale). Look like standard Raman output: col1 = wavenumber shift (cm⁻¹), col2 = intensity (counts).

## CONTENT
Comma = decimal sep confirmed, not thousands-sep: every value has 6 digits after comma, not 3-digit chunks (invalid thousands grouping) → decimal-comma parse (47183.554644) correct, thousands-comma parse (47,183,554,644) impossible/absurd.

But x-column magnitude fail sanity check as literal cm⁻¹ Raman shift: full span = 45534.8 cm⁻¹ (xmin 1648.7, xmax 47183.6). Real graphene G peak (~1580 cm⁻¹, world knowledge) falls OUTSIDE this range (below xmin). Typical grating Raman spectrometer window only ~1000–3500 cm⁻¹, this span 13-15x too wide. Divide-by-10 hypothesis (x in units of 0.1 cm⁻¹) tested: G(1580→raw 15800) and 2D(2700→raw 27000) both land centrally inside [1648.7, 47183.6] raw range — survives. Nonlinear row-spacing (595.2 → 1.03 → 0.26, monotonic shrink as x shrink) match real wavelength→wavenumber calibration curvature, consistent under either scale reading (spacing shape scale-invariant) — doesn't discriminate hypotheses but confirm axis physically real, not garbage/index.

So: locale-format itself fine (decimal comma, verified). Real mismatch = numeric scale of x-axis vs. naive "literal cm⁻¹" assumption.

CONTENT VERDICT: MISMATCH

## MISREADINGS

1. **Comma as thousands-sep** → parse fail or huge wrong int (47183554644). Evidence: digit groups after comma = 6, not 3 → invalid thousands grouping → FALSIFIED, comma is decimal.

2. **Assume ascending x order** (row0 = xmin) → wrong, file monotonic descending (stats confirm: row1 x=47183.6 max, last row x=1648.7 min). Fit code must sort/reverse before peak-fit, else x0 gamma extraction scrambled.

3. **Take x as literal cm⁻¹ Raman shift, no rescale** → G peak(1580) not in [1648.7,47183.6] range, span 45535 cm⁻¹ way beyond real instrument window → PLAUSIBLE MISREAD, likely wrong.

4. **x in units of 0.1 cm⁻¹ (scale/10)** → tested: G(15800 raw), 2D(27000 raw) both centrally inside range → SURVIVES numeric test, best candidate, but no header/units field in data to prove scale factor definitively — treat as hypothesis to confirm against actual fitted x0 (should land ~15800 and ~27000 raw, or ~1580/2700 after ÷10).
